claudexor — harness-agnostic AI coding control plane (v3.25.1)

Usage:
  claudexor init                            Scaffold repo-local config (.claudexor/config.yaml)
  claudexor doctor [--harness <id>] [--all]   Detect + conformance-test harnesses
  claudexor project list | register <root> | relink <id> <root> | remove <id> | outputs <id> [path]   Manage the durable v2 project registry
  claudexor ask "<question>" [opts]         Read-only answer/explanation route (--deep-scan widens to a multi-scout research sweep)
  claudexor agent "<prompt>" [opts]         Run a task (default mode: agent; internal model review is opt-in)
  claudexor best-of "<prompt>" [--n N]      Best-of-N run (agent --n) with cross-family review
  claudexor plan "<prompt>" [--council [--n N]]   Read-only planning report (--council: multi-harness drafts merged into one plan)
  claudexor create "<prompt>"               Create-from-scratch (agent --create)
  claudexor review --diff <file> | --evidence-dir <path> --artifacts-dir <path> ...   Reviewer-panel review of a diff or sealed frozen packet
  claudexor inspect <run_id>                Inspect a run's decision + artifacts
  claudexor follow <run_id> [--json]        Live-tail a daemon run (replay + push; answer questions in the TTY)
  claudexor retry <run_id>                  Exact Retry with the immutable original request and fresh preflight
  claudexor run-again <run_id>              Print an editable draft copied from a prior run
  claudexor apply <run_id> [--mode ...]     Apply a run's WorkProduct (apply|commit|branch|pr|--dry-run)
  claudexor decision <run_id> <action-flags>   Record a run decision: --accept-risk|--override|--revert|--discard|--accept-clean-patch [--apply-mode m]|--rerun --feedback "<text>"
  claudexor account-reset <harness/profile_id> --offer <id> --idempotency-key <key> [--grant <id>] | --operation <id>   Explicitly consume a native account reset or read its receipt
  claudexor quota [--json] [--resources] [--refresh [--profile <harness/profile_id>] [--model <id>]]   Show every vendor-owned quota window with provenance and freshness
  claudexor settings show|set               Show/update user defaults
  claudexor trust                           Show/update this repo's user-local trust
    --allow-full-access                     Permit access=full (unsandboxed) for this repo
    --revoke-full-access                    Revoke the full-access allow
    --access-default <profile>              readonly|workspace_write default for write modes
    --grant-test '<json-argv>'              Grant one exact typed-argv project gate
    --revoke-test <digest>                  Revoke an exact project gate grant
  claudexor auth status|login               Inspect native harness auth
  claudexor secrets list|set|delete         Manage stored API-key refs (v2 0600 file store)
  claudexor recovery inspect|validate|export <partition> | quarantine <partition> <fingerprint> quarantine_and_start_fresh   Inspect or recover a durable journal partition
  claudexor release check-name [name] | check | stats   Naming gate, engine runtime update check, and owner-facing install counter
  claudexor daemon start|status|stop|logs|rotate-token   Managed local daemon (claudexord)
  claudexor remote probe|bootstrap|stop <expectedVersion> <expectedBuildSha>|activate <expectedTarget|-> <nextTarget|->|rollback <expectedTarget|-> <nextTarget|-> --json   Internal SSH runtime bootstrap interface
  claudexor setup attach|cancel|reconcile <jobId>   Attach a terminal to a setup login, cancel it, or reconcile its termination
  claudexor accounts [snapshot]             Read-only atomic Accounts snapshot: profiles, readiness, quota freshness, and next-up routing
  claudexor gc [--dry-run]                  Reclaim expired run/review artifact trees (daemon retention pass)
  claudexor profiles [list | add|login|enable|disable|remove <harness> <profile-id>]   Credential profiles: registry + doctor readiness, per-profile toggle, and vendor login
  claudexor mcp serve                       Expos
